newsitem.title: UK: EBRD to back Romania post-privatisation fund.
newsitem.headline: EBRD to back Romania post-privatisation fund.

text.p: The European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD) said it was backing a Romania privatisation fund which it hoped would help end the problems of a lack of long-term finance for companies.
The EBRD will invest 25 million Ecu in the Romanian Post-Privatisation Fund. A further 14 million will come from the EU, which will also provide 10 million in technical assistance.

"(It) will make a contribution to overcoming one of the most significant stumbling blocks to the development of a sound private sector in Romania's economy...the low availability of long-term finance and risk capital to medium-sized enterprises," EBRD vice president Guy de Selliers said.
The fund will provide new equity and management assistance to companies in any sector, unable to raise private equity capital.
